name: Weather-Integrated Industrial Load Forecasting Benchmark
description: A benchmark study evaluating the impact of incorporating weather information into industrial electric load forecasting models.
reputation: New academic benchmark focused on industrial settings; limited community adoption so far but relevant to energy forecasting researchers.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark. Results are sensitive to weather forecast quality and temporal splitting; risk of temporal leakage and seasonality effects; dataset size and representativeness may limit generalization.
